claim_scope_note: The only claim addressed by this packet is C-DELTA-REPAIR (owner_lanes graph/runtime/product, registry status HYPOTHESIS, next_gate 'controlled local perturbations with repair cost and contamination bounds'). No other claim id may be advanced and no event may be emitted for C-FRESHNESS, C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-MEAS-VALID, C-PRODUCT-ECON or C-CROSSSITE. The result is a bounded, controlled-substrate measurement; it is not a Web-prevalence statement (SB-01) and it does not promote anything to Product Core (SB-05).

director_mandate_binding.binding_strategic_question: Can local delta repair, measured on a controlled credential-free multi-node substrate with an independently verifiable local-perturbation surface, repair the inherited knowledge affected by a bounded local change (blast radius 1-3: a changed field, endpoint, transport validator/token, or permission) at repair cost materially below an honest cold re-derivation under identical per-trajectory counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts), while keeping contamination (incorrectly repaired or falsely accepted items) below a preregistered bound and reporting per-family precision/recall and false-accept, so that C-DELTA-REPAIR's registry next gate (controlled local perturbations with repair cost and contamination bounds) is actually measured rather than re-assumed?
director_mandate_binding.mandate_obedience_note: The mandate's strategic question names 'permission' as one possible bound-1-3 change; on a credential-free substrate (which this design requires so that no lane depends on an unavailable model/credential/browser, per the Runtime C-MEAS-VALID dependency) permission/authority-boundary drift is structurally unreachable. This family is therefore declared NOT_APPLICABLE (SB-02) rather than dropped silently; the three reachable families (field, endpoint, transport) and a legitimate-update control cover the mandate's discriminating core. The mandate also explicitly warns that mandates avoid re-requiring the unsatisfiable V9 literal and that the freeze-time code-binding defect lives in scripts/ outside every lane's allowed_code_roots; this design therefore binds only EXECUTE-existing artifacts or declares the check NOT_APPLICABLE honestly.
explicitly_not_authorized: any claim event outside C-DELTA-REPAIR; no C-MEAS-VALID, C-FRESHNESS, C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-PRODUCT-ECON or C-CROSSSITE event
any Product Core promotion or shipped-status change
reusing the parked C-FRESHNESS four-anchor D1V route or any web anchor contact
a claim that repair generalizes beyond the frozen blast radius 1-3 and the frozen family set (SB-06)
agent_priors_used: General prior, not SPIDER evidence: a deterministic substrate where the treatment is handed the exact delta collapses repair to the oracle and yields a definitional ceiling (repair==truth, contamination==0); the design must add an observable-ambiguity stratum and a legitimate-update control so precision/recall are non-trivial and both the SUPPORTS and FALSIFIES branches remain reachable.

General prior, not SPIDER evidence: a prior distributed attempt failed at the health gate (EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 MEASUREMENT_INVALID, substrate_started=false); the design must use a substrate whose prerequisites are already present in the environment rather than pip-installed at EXECUTE time.

General prior, not SPIDER evidence: if the comparator is at a floor (cold re-derivation already minimal) or the treatment is at a ceiling, no effect is identifiable regardless of sample size, so a pre-freeze non-degeneracy/dynamic-range probe must precede any benchmark spend.

parent_handoff_continuity.disposition: SUPERSEDE as authorization (the mandate is a PIVOT to C-DELTA-REPAIR with cognitive_reset=true); the parent handoff is retained ONLY as continuity evidence and its four-way distinction is preserved verbatim below. Its next_question is NOT the objective of this experiment.
inherited_established: The parent established a licensed extraction result on C-FRESHNESS, not a repair result; it is irrelevant to this experiment's claim and is recorded only to prevent re-importing it as a repair fact.

A repaired measurement substrate existed: the corrected GATE-C3 predicate and dual independent stdlib extraction paths passed on credential-free GET-only anchors; this design borrows only the general governance lesson (fail-closed substrate certificate) and no anchor.

The anchor-clustered bootstrap estimator is certified capable of non-degenerate and degenerate bounds via a same-code-path positive/null control; this design borrows only the estimator-control PATTERN, not the D1V object.
inherited_rejected: REJECTED (by the parent): constructing a >=2-anchor D1V population from the four frozen C-FRESHNESS anchors under the frozen transport signature.
REJECTED (by the parent): reading single-anchor D1V point estimates as false-accept/blindness/necessity results.
Out of scope for this packet: any C-FRESHNESS status change or anchor contact.
inherited_unknown: Whether the parent's extraction/substrate findings generalize at all beyond its four anchors (SB-01 boundary); this experiment does not test the Web and does not import those anchors.
Whether local delta repair is a reusable multi-node capability at all: the parent did not measure repair; this experiment is the first controlled multi-node repair-cost/contamination read in R2.
The exact per-unit instrumentation cost of each counter under a real multi-node loop; the design's constants are declared in spec.counter_definitions and only ratios are gated.
inherited_do_not_assume: Do not assume the parent's C-FRESHNESS degeneracy implies anything about repair; repair and freshness are different objects.

Do not assume the prior single-node repair result (EXP-GRAPH-36018188168) transfers to a multi-node substrate without re-measurement; its deterministic single-node ceiling (contamination 0.0, repair 1.0) is exactly the degeneracy this design must avoid.

Do not assume the prior distributed failure (EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 MEASUREMENT_INVALID) was a scientific negative about repair; it was an infrastructure failure, and its leaked default constants (contamination 0.1611, amortized 15/1) must not be cited as repair evidence.
Do not treat the mandate's word 'permission' as measured; on this credential-free substrate it is NOT_APPLICABLE (SB-02).

question: On a controlled, credential-free, stdlib-only multi-node substrate (N=3 node processes with distinct PIDs and distinct local registries behind one deterministic router) with an independently verifiable local-perturbation surface (blast radius 1-3), across the reachable perturbation families FIELD, ENDPOINT and TRANSPORT plus a legitimate-update control family, can a local delta-repair treatment (T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR) repair inherited knowledge at an L1 counter cost (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts, summed over scored episodes) materially below an honest cold full re-derivation comparator (B-COLD-REDERIVE) while holding contamination and false-accept below preregistered bounds, keeping per-family precision/recall measured (not assumed), and containing every repair to the independently verified blast radius, so that C-DELTA-REPAIR's next gate is actually measured?
hypothesis: H-MAIN (cost). Across the frozen scored episodes, M_COST_RATIO = M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR / M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE is <= 0.65, because the treatment re-derives only the independently verified blast radius (1-3 items on one node) while B-COLD-REDERIVE re-derives the full inherited corpus (R=24 items over N=3 nodes) per episode. H-QUALITY. The treatment holds M_CONTAMINATION <= 0.05, M_FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.05, min over families {FIELD,ENDPOINT,TRANSPORT} of M_RECALL_FAM >= 0.9, and M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT <= 0.05, so the cost win is not bought by silent corruption. H-CONTAIN. M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT == 1.0 and M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION == 0.0: every applied mutation lies inside the independently recomputed true blast radius and no node outside it is mutated. H-NONDEGENERATE (design-level). The treatment is NOT handed the exact delta on the scored population: the surface-ambiguous stratum of FIELD, where a genuine perturbation and a legitimate update produce the same observable value-changed signal, forces the treatment to verify (cost) or abstain (UNKNOWN) or risk a false-repair/false-accept; therefore repair is not definitionally the oracle and both the SUPPORTS and FALSIFIES regions of the decision rule are arithmetically reachable (spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run).
falsifier: Frozen conditions, each pre-labelled. F-VALID: any measurement-validity gate fails (substrate health/identity V02; independent perturbation verification V03; counter-instrumentation consistency V04; control-channel isolation V05; raw retention V06; determinism V07; frozen-input integrity V08; credential-free loopback-only V09; treatment-liveness smoke V11) -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE, no claim-level statement. F-INSTR: a positive control fails (PC-DETECT-CANARY recall != 1.0; PC-COST-CANARY fails to separate B-COLD-REDERIVE from B-LOCAL-ORACLE; PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS fixture mismatch) or a null control is insensitive (B-NOOP-STALE fails to exhibit contamination > bound on perturbed items, so the contamination metric cannot detect failure; or B-COLD-REDERIVE fails to reach contamination 0, so the metric is stuck) -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID, INCONCLUSIVE. F-COST (falsifies H-MAIN): M_COST_RATIO >= 1.0 -> LOCAL-REPAIR-NO-WORK-SAVED. F-QUALITY (falsifies H-QUALITY): M_CONTAMINATION > 0.20 OR min family M_RECALL < 0.5 -> REPAIR-LEAKY. F-CONTAIN (falsifies H-CONTAIN): M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT < 1.0 OR M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION > 0.0 -> REPAIR-OVERREACH, a bounded falsification of local containment on this substrate. F-MIXED: 0.65 < M_COST_RATIO < 1.0, or cost <= 0.65 with a quality/containment failure not severe enough for F-QUALITY/F-CONTAIN -> INTERMEDIATE. Every terminal branch either emits a bounded C-DELTA-REPAIR statement (SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES/MIXED, all status=COMPLETE) or is a measurement-invalid/inconclusive state that is explicitly NOT a scientific negative (SB-08).

substrate.class: CONTROLLED, CREDENTIAL-FREE, STDLIB-ONLY, LOOPBACK-ONLY MULTI-NODE HTTP SUBSTRATE (no Flask/PyJWT/nginx/gunicorn/SQLite dependency)
substrate.why_this_class: The prior distributed attempt (EXP-GRAPH-36106653880) failed at health because its Flask+PyJWT+gunicorn+nginx substrate was not robustly startable in the environment. Design self-attack (SA-04) rejected any substrate requiring pip installs. The DESIGN satisfiability probe started N=3 stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer node processes plus a stdlib router on ephemeral loopback ports and observed 3 distinct node identities and successful routed reads, so this class is proven startable before freeze.

nodes.implementation: one independent OS process per node, each http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer on its own loopback port, each with its own local JSON registry file under a per-node temp directory
nodes.identity_surface: each node exposes /health -> {status, node_pid, node_id, registry_sha256}; distinct OS PIDs and distinct registry paths are the multi-node identity evidence
nodes.knowledge: each node holds the inherited record subset assigned to it by the deterministic router key; the inherited corpus is R=24 records

router.implementation: stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer that deterministically maps a request key (resource_id, and for ENDPOINT/TRANSPORT families a synthetic family key) to exactly one node
router.role: the system under test sees a single base URL; the router is the only client-facing entrypoint

substrate.credential_free: no Authorization header, no JWT, no cookie, no session, no credential of any kind is required or accepted; every scored request is an idempotent GET; no write verb is exposed to the system under test

perturbation_surface.controller: an out-of-band perturbation controller (NOT the system under test) mutates node registry files between episodes through a control channel the system under test cannot read or write
perturbation_surface.independent_verification: for every perturbation the controller retains the pre-mutation and post-mutation registry file sha256 for all N nodes and the node-PID map; a verifier module that shares NO localization code with the treatment recomputes the TRUE blast radius (set of (node_id, record_id, field/path)) and the TRUE post-perturbation ground-truth value set from those retained snapshots
perturbation_surface.why_this_is_stronger_than_self_report: contamination, precision, recall, false-accept and blast-radius containment can all be scored against a ground truth the treatment did not produce and cannot see

FIELD.description: one field value on one record on one node changes; observable surface is a value mismatch on the served field.

ENDPOINT.description: the response schema of one record family on one node changes (field added, removed or retyped; path-normalization changes).

TRANSPORT.description: a node changes its validator semantics: ETag emitted from a different scheme, or If-None-Match handling changes so a stale body yields 304 (false-fresh) or a fresh body is served after a 304-triggering token.

LEGIT.description: LEGITIMATE-UPDATE CONTROL: a value changes through a pre-registered legitimate update channel; it MUST NOT be treated as requiring repair. Not a perturbation family for recall; scored for false-repair and contamination.

PERMISSION.reason: SB-02: permission/authority-boundary drift requires credentialed/authenticated state, which a credential-free substrate structurally forbids. The nearest reachable analogue (a node-local capability flag governing field visibility) is a strict subset of ENDPOINT and is therefore not admitted as a distinct family. Declared, not silently dropped.

substrate.ambiguity_design: Within FIELD, a pre-registered surface-ambiguous stratum presents the SAME observable signal (a changed value with shape-invariant schema and normal transport) for both a genuine perturbation and a LEGIT legitimate update. On this stratum the treatment cannot be definitionally certain; it must verify (counter cost), abstain UNKNOWN, or accept the risk of false-repair/false-accept. This is what keeps the treatment below the oracle ceiling and makes precision/recall non-trivial (H-NONDEGENERATE).
substrate.determinism: a single frozen seed (38085175893) drives all layout/scheduling/ambiguity assignment via random.Random(seed); Python process-randomized hash() is never used as a seed or layout key; registry files are canonical JSON with sorted keys
substrate.environment: CPython 3.12 stdlib only; Python 3.12.15 present in the design environment; no external network, no model, no browser, no credential, no pip install at EXECUTE time (V09)

treatment.description: Maintain per-node inherited knowledge plus a verifier. For each scored episode (a query whose served value fails verification), localize the affected node and key deterministically from the router key; re-fetch ONLY the affected node's affected record(s) within the detected scope; re-derive the delta; apply a MINIMAL mutation to the affected local registry; re-verify; mark repaired on success. On surface-ambiguous observations the treatment may abstain (UNKNOWN) and bill a bounded cold re-derivation fallback for that single item. It never mutates a node outside the independently recomputed blast radius.
treatment.liveness_requirement: V11 treatment-liveness smoke test: before scoring, the treatment must execute end-to-end on one canary episode and produce a verifier-consistent repaired state; a structurally non-executable treatment is a DESIGN/EXECUTE failure (MEASUREMENT_INVALID), never a scientific negative.

counter_definitions.http_requests: each outbound HTTP request the system under test issues to the substrate (router or node) during a scored episode, counted at the client boundary.
counter_definitions.retrieval_calls: each distinct lookup into inherited knowledge (a local-registry read or a cross-node knowledge retrieval) during a scored episode.
counter_definitions.verification_calls: each independent verification pass over a candidate reconciled value (a re-fetch-and-compare or a verifier-oracle invocation) during a scored episode.
counter_definitions.repair_attempts: each mutation/apply attempt to a local registry (including rejected or rolled-back attempts) during a scored episode.
counter_definitions.aggregation: M_COST_VECTOR_X = element-wise sum of the four counters over all scored episodes for arm X; M_COST_L1_X = sum of the four components; M_COST_RATIO = M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR / M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE.
counter_definitions.instrumentation_consistency: client-boundary counters are cross-checked against raw per-request logs (V04); any discrepancy is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

baselines.note: Frozen identities shared verbatim with EXECUTE/AUDIT/DIRECTOR. All arms share the identical counter instrumentation and the identical scored episode set.

B-COLD-REDERIVE.description: Honest cold full re-derivation: for each scored episode, re-derive the full inherited corpus (all N nodes, all R records) from scratch with fresh verification and no reuse of inherited knowledge.
B-COLD-REDERIVE.role: primary cost comparator for M_COST_RATIO and the honest work-avoided reference.

B-NOOP-STALE.description: Null comparator: serve inherited knowledge unchanged, with no detection and no repair.
B-NOOP-STALE.role: proves the contamination/false-accept metrics can detect failure (NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY).

B-FULL-REFRESH.description: Cost-ceiling comparator: on the first detected change in an episode, refresh the entire corpus.
B-FULL-REFRESH.role: establishes the cost ceiling (M_COST_RATIO approaching 1.0) and makes the F-COST/FALSIFIES branch reachable.

B-LOCAL-ORACLE.description: Definitional floor: given the true delta, apply only the minimal mutations to the affected registry.
B-LOCAL-ORACLE.role: establishes the cost floor; used by PC-COST-CANARY to prove the ceiling is not below the floor and the counter instrument has dynamic range. NOT a scientific arm.

PC-DETECT-CANARY.requirement: On a pre-registered fully-observable FIELD canary episode, T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR must detect and repair the perturbation so that M_RECALL_FIELD on the canary == 1.0 and M_CANARY_PASS == true.
PC-DETECT-CANARY.why_it_is_a_real_control: A zero-recall treatment cannot be distinguished from an incapable instrument; the canary pins the instrument's ability to fire.

PC-COST-CANARY.requirement: On the same episode, M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE must be strictly greater than M_COST_L1_B-LOCAL-ORACLE; M_COST_SEPARATION_PASS == true.
PC-COST-CANARY.why_it_is_a_real_control: Proves the counter instrument separates full-corpus work from minimal work; without it a flat cost_ratio cannot be interpreted.

PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS.requirement: On a synthetic fixture where the treatment is handed the exact delta, its output registry state must be byte-equal (canonical JSON) to the independently computed ground-truth state; M_REPAIR_FIXTURE_PASS == true.
PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS.why_it_is_a_real_control: A treatment that cannot even reproduce truth given the delta has a defective apply path; failure is a measurement failure, not a negative.

NC-NOOP-NO-PERTURBATION.requirement: On a no-perturbation replicate, M_CONTAMINATION == 0, M_FALSE_ACCEPT == 0 and M_FALSE_REPAIR == 0 (the treatment makes no spurious mutations).
NC-NOOP-NO-PERTURBATION.why: A treatment that mutates without cause corrupts the substrate.

NC-LEGIT-NO-REPAIR.requirement: On the LEGIT family, M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT <= 0.05: legitimate updates must not be classified as perturbations requiring repair.

NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY.requirement: On perturbed items B-NOOP-STALE must exhibit M_CONTAMINATION > the contamination bound (the metric detects failure), while B-COLD-REDERIVE must reach M_CONTAMINATION == 0 on the same items (the metric is not stuck).
NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY.why: A metric that cannot read both failure and success controls nothing.

NC-VERIFIER-INDEPENDENCE.requirement: The independently recomputed true blast radius and ground-truth value set must exactly match the perturbation controller's retained pre/post registry snapshots; the verifier shares no localization code path with the treatment; any mismatch is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

NC-CONTAMINATION-BYTE-EXACT.requirement: Contamination, precision, recall and false-accept are computed by byte-exact comparison to the independently recomputed ground truth, never from the treatment's self-report.
NC-CONTAMINATION-BYTE-EXACT.why: Prevents a treatment from manufacturing its own success criterion.

metrics.M_COST_RATIO: M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR / M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE (primary cost metric; lower is better).
metrics.M_COST_L1_T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR: sum of the four frozen counters for the treatment.
metrics.M_COST_L1_B-COLD-REDERIVE: sum of the four frozen counters for cold full re-derivation.
metrics.M_COST_L1_B-LOCAL-ORACLE: sum of the four frozen counters for the definitional floor (dynamic-range reference).
metrics.M_CONTAMINATION: fraction of all served answers (perturbed + LEGIT + no-perturbation items) that are byte-inexact versus independently recomputed ground truth.
metrics.M_FALSE_ACCEPT: fraction of scored items where the treatment serves or preserves a stale/incorrect value while claiming a consistent/repaired state.
metrics.M_PRECISION_FIELD: precision of the treatment's repair detections on the FIELD family.
metrics.M_PRECISION_ENDPOINT: precision of the treatment's repair detections on the ENDPOINT family.
metrics.M_PRECISION_TRANSPORT: precision of the treatment's repair detections on the TRANSPORT family.
metrics.M_RECALL_FIELD: recall on the FIELD family (genuine perturbations repaired / genuine perturbations).
metrics.M_FALSE_REPAIR: fraction of unperturbed items mutated by the treatment.
metrics.M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT: fraction of LEGIT (legitimate-update) items mutated by the treatment.
metrics.M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT: fraction of perturbations whose applied mutation set is a subset of the independently recomputed true blast radius.
metrics.M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION: fraction of perturbed episodes in which a node outside the true blast radius is mutated or serves a byte-inexact value attributable to the perturbation.
metrics.M_UNKNOWN_RATE: fraction of episodes where the treatment abstains (UNKNOWN) instead of repairing.

ordered.condition: all blocking measurement-validity checks pass (V02-V09, V11) and all three positive controls pass and all null controls are sensitive
ordered.consequence: no C-DELTA-REPAIR scientific statement; operational failure is not falsification (SB-08)

ordered.condition: M_COST_RATIO <= 0.65 AND M_CONTAMINATION <= 0.05 AND M_FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.05 AND min(M_RECALL_FIELD, M_RECALL_ENDPOINT, M_RECALL_TRANSPORT) >= 0.9 AND M_FALSE_REPAIR_LEGIT <= 0.05 AND M_BLAST_RADIUS_CONTAINMENT == 1.0 AND M_CROSS_NODE_CONTAMINATION == 0.0
ordered.consequence: bounded local-repair capability measured on the controlled substrate; C-DELTA-REPAIR's next gate is measured (status remains HYPOTHESIS, DIRECTOR decides any change)
local repair saves no work versus honest cold re-derivation on this substrate
cost work is not reliable repair
repair is not locally contained on this substrate

ordered.condition: otherwise (0.65 < M_COST_RATIO < 1.0, OR M_COST_RATIO <= 0.65 with a quality/containment shortfall not severe enough for FALSIFIES-QUALITY/FALSIFIES-CONTAIN)
ordered.consequence: partial save or partial reliability; bounded report, no capability claim

decision_rule.branch_reachability: Proven reachable pre-freeze in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run: SUPPORTS (cost_ratio in [0.0625,0.1458] with clean quality), FALSIFIES-COST (a treatment that over-re-derives drives cost_ratio to ~1.0; B-FULL-REFRESH realises it), FALSIFIES-QUALITY (a leaky arm reaches contamination 0.233 and recall 0.5), FALSIFIES-CONTAIN (any out-of-radius mutation), and MIXED (cost win with quality shortfall, e.g. contamination 0.233 / recall 0.5 at cost_ratio 0.146). No branch is empty.

pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.status: EXECUTED BY DESIGN on a stdlib synthetic probe only; NO substrate-under-test episode, NO confirmatory measurement, NO web, NO model, NO credential. It exercises the same counter arithmetic, decision thresholds and dynamic-range logic EXECUTE will freeze.

component_A_substrate_feasibility.detail: The probe started N=3 independent stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer node processes plus one stdlib deterministic router on ephemeral loopback ports; 12 routed reads returned 3 distinct node identities (pids 40000,40001,40002) and routed_ok=true; stdlib_only=true. No Flask/PyJWT/nginx/gunicorn/SQLite was required. This disproves the /tmp scratch-directory misconception for the new experiment before EXECUTE exists and removes the EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 health-gate failure mode.

component_B_branch_arithmetic.detail: With R=24 records over N=3 nodes, blast radius b in [1,3] and the frozen counter aggregation, the treatment cost_ratio range is [0.0625,0.1458] (oracle floor 0.0625; B-FULL-REFRESH ceiling 1.0). SUPPORTS (<=0.65) is reachable; FALSIFIES-COST (>=1.0) is reachable via a full re-derivation per episode; MIXED is reachable (cost_ratio 0.146 with contamination 0.233 / recall 0.5). The SUPPORTS ceiling 0.65 is strictly above the floor 0.0625, so the support threshold is not below the definitional floor and not a tautological ceiling.

component_C_bounds_non_vacuity.detail: Under the frozen metric definitions: a reachable PASS case gives M_CONTAMINATION 0.0167 (<=0.05), M_FALSE_ACCEPT 0.0278 (<=0.05), M_RECALL_FIELD 0.917 (>=0.9); a reachable FAIL case gives M_CONTAMINATION 0.2333 (>0.05), M_FALSE_ACCEPT 0.1667 (>0.05), M_RECALL_FIELD 0.5 (<0.9). Both regions of every bound are arithmetically reachable, so the bounds are non-vacuous and discriminating.

branch_reachability_matrix.GATE-V_MEASUREMENT_INVALID: reachable (substrate start failure, counter mismatch, verifier mismatch, control-channel leak, liveness failure)
branch_reachability_matrix.SUPPORTS: reachable (cost_ratio ~0.06-0.15 with clean quality and perfect containment)
branch_reachability_matrix.FALSIFIES-COST: reachable (B-FULL-REFRESH cost_ratio ~1.0; or a treatment that re-derives the full corpus per episode)
branch_reachability_matrix.FALSIFIES-CONTAIN: reachable (any mutation outside the true blast radius)
branch_reachability_matrix.MIXED: reachable (cost win with quality shortfall; or cost in (0.65,1.0))

estimator_control_fixture.note: No bootstrap estimator is used by this experiment; the analogous non-vacuity guarantee is the dynamic-range control PC-COST-CANARY (B-COLD-REDERIVE strictly above B-LOCAL-ORACLE) plus the contamination PASS/FAIL witnesses above. Declared explicitly so AUDIT does not look for an unused estimator control.

self_attack_findings.finding: The first-drafted decision rule's MIXED reachability check ignored the 'cost win but quality fails' subcase and reported MIXED unreachable.
self_attack_findings.resolution: MIXED redefined as 'otherwise', explicitly including cost_ratio<=0.65 with a quality/containment shortfall; a witness (cost_ratio 0.146, contamination 0.233, recall 0.5) is recorded; the probe was corrected and re-run.

self_attack_findings.finding: The mandate names 'permission' as a blast-radius-1-3 change, but permission drift is structurally unreachable on a credential-free substrate.
self_attack_findings.resolution: PERMISSION declared NOT_APPLICABLE with reason SB-02; the nearest analogue (node-local capability flag governing field visibility) is a strict subset of ENDPOINT, so it is not admitted as a distinct family. No silent drop.

self_attack_findings.finding: A deterministic substrate that hands the treatment the exact delta collapses repair to the oracle (repair==truth, contamination==0), reproducing the EXP-GRAPH-36018188168 single-node definitional ceiling and making precision/recall trivial.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Added a pre-registered surface-ambiguous FIELD stratum (genuine perturbation and legitimate update share the same observably changed signal) and a LEGIT control family; the treatment must verify, abstain or risk error, so it cannot be at the oracle ceiling and precision/recall are non-trivial.

self_attack_findings.finding: Any substrate requiring pip-installed Flask/PyJWT/gunicorn/nginx reproduces the EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 MEASUREMENT_INVALID health-gate failure.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Design fixed to stdlib-only loopback HTTP node processes; a pre-freeze probe started 3 nodes + router successfully. The 3-node/1-router design is feasible without any install.

self_attack_findings.finding: Contamination/containment scored from treatment self-report would let the treatment define its own success.
self_attack_findings.resolution: Added NC-CONTAMINATION-BYTE-EXACT and NC-VERIFIER-INDEPENDENCE: an independent verifier recomputes ground truth and blast radius from retained pre/post registry snapshots by byte-exact comparison.

self_attack_findings.finding: The NUMERIC cost threshold 0.65 could have been set below the definitional floor, making SUPPORTS tautological, or above the ceiling, making it unreachable.
self_attack_findings.resolution: The probe fixes floor 0.0625, ceiling 1.0 and threshold 0.65 strictly inside the open interval; both SUPPORTS and FALSIFIES-COST are reachable.

self_attack_findings.finding: freeze_artifacts could not bind the EXECUTE-written runner/substrate/verifier code because those files do not exist at freeze and the DESIGN write scope forbids creating them.
self_attack_findings.resolution: freeze_artifacts declared [] with freeze_artifacts_bound=NOT_APPLICABLE and the exact reason; the planned EXECUTE code files and their required roles are enumerated in spec.code_binding and MUST be hashed into result.json.artifacts (role 'code') and provenance.json.

pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.no_outcome_claim: The probe measures no repair behaviour of the real treatment and cannot pre-empt the confirmatory objects (cost ratio, contamination, precision/recall, containment). It only proves feasibility and arithmetic reachability.

measurement_validity.requirement: This spec and prereg.md are written before any substrate episode. DESIGN performed no confirmatory measurement: no substrate-under-test perturbation, no treatment evaluation. The only DESIGN computation is the synthetic stdlib satisfiability probe.
measurement_validity.why: Research 2.0 packet contract and architecture section 5.

measurement_validity.requirement: At EXECUTE start, verify N=3 node processes are alive with distinct OS PIDs and distinct registry paths, and the router health endpoint returns a routed read; any failure is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID (not a scientific negative).
measurement_validity.why: The prior distributed failure was a health-gate infrastructure failure; fail closed, not open.

measurement_validity.requirement: Retain pre/post registry sha256 for all nodes and independently recompute the true blast radius and ground-truth value set; a verifier/treatment code-path mismatch is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.why: Containment and contamination must rest on independently recomputed ground truth.

measurement_validity.requirement: Client-boundary counters are cross-checked against raw per-request logs; any discrepancy is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.why: Cost is the primary metric; its instrument must be internally consistent.

measurement_validity.requirement: The system under test cannot read or write the perturbation controller's ledger or control channel (verified by isolation attestation); the treatment never receives the true delta on the scored population.
measurement_validity.why: Otherwise the treatment could read the ground truth and collapse to the oracle.

measurement_validity.requirement: Retain all episode request/response records, per-node registry snapshots (pre/post every perturbation), counter logs and the independent ground-truth recomputation; the whole measurement must be re-analyzable without re-running.
measurement_validity.why: The prior distributed failure was unrecoverable because evidence was not retained.

measurement_validity.requirement: A single frozen seed (38085175893) drives all layout/scheduling/ambiguity assignment via random.Random(seed); Python process-randomized hash() is never used as a seed or layout key.

Re-verify request.json/spec.json/prereg.md against freeze.json sha256 before the first episode and after the last; hash every producer source file into result.json.artifacts (role 'code') and provenance.json.

The substrate is local loopback only; every scored request is an idempotent GET; no credential, token, cookie, session, browser or external network is used; no write verb is exposed to the system under test. Violation is terminal MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity.why: Keeps the substrate reproducible and independent of unavailable external services/credentials.

measurement_validity.requirement: Each gated bound must have both a reachable PASS and a reachable FAIL region, documented in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run; the support threshold must lie strictly above the definitional floor and strictly below the full-refresh ceiling.
measurement_validity.why: Prevents a tautological or unreachable decision.

measurement_validity.requirement: Before scoring, the treatment must complete one canary episode end-to-end with a verifier-consistent repaired state.
measurement_validity.why: A structurally non-executable treatment is a DESIGN/EXECUTE failure, not a scientific negative.

measurement_validity.requirement: Record explicitly that this experiment is a DISTINCT_EXTENSION from the pre-2.0 repair-round artifacts (which repaired rejected experiment runs / orchestration, not inherited Web knowledge) and from the prior R2 single-node and distributed delta-repair packets (different measured object: multi-node repair cost + contamination under controlled local perturbations).
measurement_validity.why: Prevents re-running an identical or already-closed design.

code_binding.freeze_time_existing_dependencies: NONE mutable and interpretation-critical. The design depends only on immutable accepted evidence (parent packet, Codex claim state, frozen request) referenced by path, and on EXECUTE-authored code which does not yet exist at freeze time.

planned_execute_code_files_must_be_hashe.purpose: episode runner, treatment, comparators, counter instrumentation
stdlib node process with per-node registry
out-of-band perturbation controller and independent verifier

code_binding.requirement: EXECUTE MUST hash each produced file (sha256) into result.json.artifacts with role 'code' or 'fixture' and into provenance.json; the independent auditor recomputes these hashes. Because these files do not exist at freeze time and scripts/check_scope.py's DESIGN scope forbids DESIGN from creating them, they cannot be listed in spec.freeze_artifacts (the freezer rejects non-existent paths). This is the declared freeze-time code-binding limitation; those files are mutable for the transaction and MUST be bound at EXECUTE.
code_binding.at_execute_also_reuse_unchanged: The frozen request.json/spec.json/prereg.md/design_review.json and the frozen seed; no external data.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every ordered branch is reachable and non-empty, proven in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run: SUPPORTS (cost_ratio 0.0625-0.1458 with clean quality), FALSIFIES-COST (>=1.0, realised by B-FULL-REFRESH), FALSIFIES-QUALITY (contamination 0.233 / recall 0.5), FALSIFIES-CONTAIN (out-of-radius mutation), MIXED (cost win with quality shortfall, witness cost_ratio 0.146 / contamination 0.233 / recall 0.5). GATE-V is reachable via the enumerated validity failures. The support threshold 0.65 lies strictly above the definitional floor 0.0625 and below the ceiling 1.0, so SUPPORTS is neither tautological nor unreachable. Self-attack SA-01 fixed the earlier MIXED mis-specification.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All prerequisites exist now and are local: CPython 3.12 stdlib only (no Flask/PyJWT/nginx/gunicorn/SQLite/pip install), loopback networking, and enough ephemeral ports. The DESIGN probe already started N=3 stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer nodes plus a router and read through them successfully, so the substrate class is proven startable before freeze. No external network, model, credential, browser, task bank or dataset is required. The treatment-liveness smoke test (V11) is a pre-scoring smoke, not a deferred prerequisite for the design's satisfiability.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The four arms are deterministic, distinguishable program behaviours with known signatures under the identical counter instrumentation: B-LOCAL-ORACLE touches only the minimal mutation set (floor 0.0625); T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR adds bounded fetch/verify for blast radius 1-3; B-COLD-REDERIVE re-derives the full R=24 / N=3 corpus per episode; B-FULL-REFRESH is the cost ceiling (~1.0). PC-COST-CANARY proves the instrument separates floor from cold re-derivation. There is no guaranteed ceiling/floor collapse of the compared pair: the treatment is deliberately kept below the oracle by the surface-ambiguous stratum and the LEGIT control, so repair is not definitionally the ground truth. The comparator pair (treatment vs B-COLD-REDERIVE) is the mandated object and is identifiable.

control_sensitivity.reason: Every control has a pre-declared firing/abstaining outcome and pre-declared pass/fail arithmetic computed by the SAME treatment/counter code that scores the question: PC-DETECT-CANARY requires canary recall == 1.0; PC-COST-CANARY requires cold > oracle strictly; PC-REPAIR-SEMANTICS requires byte-equal output on a given-delta fixture; NC-NOOP-NO-PERTURBATION requires contamination/false-repair == 0; NC-LEGIT-NO-REPAIR requires false-repair <= 0.05; NC-INSTRUMENT-SENSITIVITY requires B-NOOP-STALE contamination > bound AND B-COLD-REDERIVE contamination == 0 on the same items; NC-VERIFIER-INDEPENDENCE requires an exact independent recompute. Both PASS and FAIL regions of every bound are arithmetically reachable (component_C). The controls are not tautological: they operate on canary/legitimate/synthetic fixtures with pre-declared expectations.

treatment_liveness.reason: The decision-relevant treatment T-LOCAL-DELTA-REPAIR is a concrete, executable program: read the router-keyed node/record, re-fetch the affected record(s), re-derive, apply a minimal registry mutation, re-verify. Design proven satisfiable: the probe already demonstrated the substrate the treatment needs (3 stdlib nodes + router + routed reads) and the arithmetic shows the treatment can land in all decision regions. V11 mandates a pre-scoring liveness smoke test; a structurally non-executable treatment is a DESIGN/EXECUTE failure (MEASUREMENT_INVALID), not a scientific result. No branch of the decision rule is structurally empty for the treatment.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: No freeze-time-existing mutable local code/data/task-bank/fixture dependency exists. The only mutable local dependencies are the EXECUTE-authored producer files (episode runner, node, router, perturbation controller/verifier, fixtures), which do not exist yet because the DESIGN write scope (scripts/check_scope.py stage 'design') allows only spec.json/prereg.md/design_review.json/failure.json/model_design.json and forbids creating code. scripts/freeze_experiment.py.safe_repo_file rejects non-existent paths, so those files cannot be listed in freeze_artifacts; their identity is instead bound at EXECUTE by sha256 into result.json.artifacts (role 'code'/'fixture') and provenance.json, as enumerated in spec.code_binding. The pre-existing static artifacts this design relies on (the frozen request and the immutable accepted parent packet / Codex claim state) are immutable and referenced by path, not mutable local fixtures. This is the same honest freeze-time code-binding limitation the Director's mandate acknowledges (the defect lives in scripts/, outside every lane's allowed_code_roots), and it is declared rather than hidden.

legacy_distinctness.pre_2_0_archive: The indexed pre-2.0 graph repair artifacts (results/graph/cycle3_REPAIR_ROUND1_recount.json sha256 f2239dd8dfb2f4744895bb9c3a6495646cfab31c; results/graph/fused_REPAIR_ROUND1_recount.json sha256 c7a052ea28929a9a62813b230480118d209eccde; reports/graph/robustness_repair_round1.md sha256 032c11f915eb4b235f2cba0fd907f9a81a0122b7; reports/graph/procedure_compilation_p0.md sha256 12eac599c2e907e442f74d48625bf404b259a74f) concern repairing REJECTED EXPERIMENT RUNS / orchestration and procedure compilation, not local delta repair of inherited Web knowledge under controlled perturbations. This experiment is therefore a DISTINCT_EXTENSION, matching the Director's comparative_reasoning and the mandate's legacy classification.
legacy_distinctness.r2_predecessors: EXP-GRAPH-35952148696 (synthetic single-resource blast radius 1; inherited synthetic ceiling) and EXP-GRAPH-36018188168 (single-node deterministic substrate; contamination 0.0, repair 1.0 definitional ceiling) measured single-node repair; EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 (distributed) was MEASUREMENT_INVALID at the health gate. This experiment changes the measured object to a MULTI-NODE repair-cost and contamination-bound read on an independently verifiable perturbation surface, avoiding both the single-node definitional ceiling (via the surface-ambiguous stratum and LEGIT control) and the prior health-gate failure (via a stdlib-only substrate proven startable pre-freeze).
legacy_distinctness.not_a_rerun: It does not repeat the SPIDER_CODEX_ULTIME repair-round recounts, does not contact web anchors, does not re-litigate C-FRESHNESS D1V, and does not import the failed distributed packet's leaked defaults.

scope_boundaries.SB-01: Every result is bounded to the frozen controlled substrate (N=3 stdlib nodes, R=24 records, blast radius 1-3, the frozen family set, the single frozen seed). No Web-prevalence or 'the Web' statement.
scope_boundaries.SB-02: PERMISSION-family repairability is NOT_APPLICABLE on this credential-free substrate; the mandate's 'permission' clause is declared unreachable, not silently dropped.
scope_boundaries.SB-03: No external network, model, credential, browser or task bank is used; all evidence is local.
scope_boundaries.SB-04: Only C-DELTA-REPAIR is addressed; no other claim event may be emitted.
scope_boundaries.SB-05: No Product Core promotion and no shipped-status change; only the DIRECTOR may change claim status.
scope_boundaries.SB-06: No claim that repair generalizes beyond blast radius 1-3 or beyond the frozen families.
scope_boundaries.SB-07: The substrate is synthetic/controlled; this is not real-Web verification.
scope_boundaries.SB-08: MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE is an operational state, never a scientific falsification of C-DELTA-REPAIR.
scope_boundaries.SB-09: DISTINCT_EXTENSION from the pre-2.0 repair-round artifacts and the prior R2 single-node/distributed packets.
scope_boundaries.SB-10: Single environment and single seed; no amortization-over-population or prevalence claim.

product_consequence_positive: If SUPPORTS: C-DELTA-REPAIR's registry next gate ('controlled local perturbations with repair cost and contamination bounds') is measured on a multi-node substrate for the first time in R2, giving the Product/Runtime lanes a bounded, auditable work-avoided ratio and a contamination/false-accept envelope for local delta repair. This is decision-relevant input to whether delta-repair instrumentation is worth building at all. It does NOT by itself authorize any Product Core promotion, shipping, or status change (SB-05); the DIRECTOR decides bounded status movement from the frozen packet plus independent audit.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIES or MIXED: the product decision is to NOT invest in local-only delta repair as currently framed and to prefer honest cold re-derivation or a guard-first approach, with the specific failure mode recorded (no work saved / leaky / overreach). C-DELTA-REPAIR remains HYPOTHESIS (or the DIRECTOR records the bounded negative); no capability claim is made. A negative is first-class and prevents spending product effort on an unmeasured capability.
estimated_cost: Local, credential-free, no model calls and no external network. Bounded budget: N=3 stdlib node processes + 1 router + 1 perturbation controller; R=24 records; a scored suite of at most 200 episodes across families (FIELD, ENDPOINT, TRANSPORT, LEGIT) plus canary/null/fixture controls; total counter L1 across all arms well under 4000 units; wall-clock minutes on the runner; retention of all raw records and registry snapshots. No tokens, no browser, no retrieval service.
expected_information_gain: HIGH. There is currently no R2 measurement of multi-node local delta-repair cost and contamination under an independently verifiable perturbation surface; C-DELTA-REPAIR's next gate has been re-assumed rather than measured since EXP-GRAPH-36018188168 (single-node, definitionally degenerate) and EXP-GRAPH-36106653880 (MEASUREMENT_INVALID). This experiment either licenses a bounded measured repair capability or closes it with a specific failure mode, changing the build/no-build decision for delta repair.
